entities.name: Query ELOVL protein
observations: 385 aa, highly hydrophobic multi-pass membrane protein with predicted ELO domain PF01151 spanning residues 18–254.
Matches reviewed ELOVL6 homologs Q5ZJR8, Q9H5J4, and Q920L5 at 91.2–96.1% identity with approximately 67% query coverage.
Sequence-based identification supports an endoplasmic-reticulum fatty-acid elongase, but exact substrate preference is inferred from homologs rather than directly demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: ELOVL condensation reaction
observations: Condensation step of microsomal fatty-acid elongation: very-long-chain acyl-CoA + malonyl-CoA + H+ → very-long-chain 3-oxoacyl-CoA + CO2 + CoA.
Representative reaction: hexadecanoyl-CoA + malonyl-CoA + H+ → 3-oxooctadecanoyl-CoA + CO2 + CoA, Rhea RHEA:35315; EC 2.3.1.199.
This is the first and rate-limiting step of the four-step elongation cycle and adds two carbons to the acyl chain.

entities.name: Microsomal fatty acid elongation
observations: The elongase condensation reaction feeds the subsequent reduction, dehydration, and reduction steps that produce elongated saturated, monounsaturated, or low-desaturation fatty acyl-CoAs in the ER.

entities.name: ELOVL6 cofactor status
observations: No separately required metal, flavin, pyridine nucleotide, or other cofactor is reported for the ELOVL6 condensation step in the retrieved annotations; malonyl-CoA is a substrate/co-substrate, not a cofactor.
